neighbours.label: Fires on the first piece of a word that is about to spell 'asset' in another script or identifier: CJK '資' in 資產/安全資產 (asset), Arabic ' الأ'/' أس' word-starts in finance text, 'AS' in ASSET_* constants, and '_fixed' in fixed-asset style names. It sits where the next token would be 'asset' (it suppresses the asset tokens).
